admission.justification: A future history writer or worklist refactor must not accept a row in place of repairing a removed retrieval target, leaving durable records pointing at code the leaf deleted.

applicability: Non-reconsider_on links retained from base records in a converted leaf when the leaf removes their code path, directory or previously resolving symbol.
conditions: Only a retained target key is checked; a key removed or restated in the candidate no longer supplies the old broken pointer.
A code path/directory gone at C, or symbol resolving at B and not C, produces the link_target obligation.
The registered link_target row lookup is empty: repairing the candidate link, not an ordinary history row, is the recovery.
exclusions: Content-only changes of a retrieval pointer do not themselves raise this item.
reconsider_on is handled by its separate reconsideration mechanism, not by this collector.
statement: A non-reconsideration record link whose path, route or symbol the leaf removed remains an open link_target until that target key is restated or removed, never answered by a row.
